text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At long last, the Arima Kinen has arrived, and the stage is set for the ultimate sibling showdown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide can't even remember the last time she and her sister raced each other. While acknowledging Narita Brian's abilities, she proclaims that she will win this climactic confrontation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This time, she will be the one to triumph! The final showdown with Narita Brian the Beast begins!
